scripts.dev: set -a && source .env.dev && echo "[DEV]  NODE_ENV=$NODE_ENV  Portal=$PORT  Auth=$AUTH_PORT  DB=$DB_NAME" && python3 -c "import os; print(f'   DB connect → {os.environ.get(\"DB_USER\")}@${os.environ.get(\"DB_HOST\")}:${os.environ.get(\"DB_PORT\")}/${os.environ.get(\"DB_NAME\")}')"
scripts.stg: set -a && source .env.stg && echo "[STG]  NODE_ENV=$NODE_ENV  Portal=$PORT  Auth=$AUTH_PORT  DB=$DB_NAME" && python3 -c "import os; print(f'   DB connect → {os.environ.get(\"DB_USER\")}@${os.environ.get(\"DB_HOST\")}:${os.environ.get(\"DB_PORT\")}/${os.environ.get(\"DB_NAME\")}')"
scripts.prd: set -a && source .env.prd && echo "[PRD]  NODE_ENV=$NODE_ENV  Portal=$PORT  Auth=$AUTH_PORT  DB=$DB_NAME" && python3 -c "import os; print(f'   DB connect → {os.environ.get(\"DB_USER\")}@${os.environ.get(\"DB_HOST\")}:${os.environ.get(\"DB_PORT\")}/${os.environ.get(\"DB_NAME\")}')"
scripts.db:test:dev: set -a && source .env.dev && PGPASSWORD=$DB_PASS /opt/homebrew/opt/postgresql@16/bin/psql -h $DB_HOST -p $DB_PORT -U $DB_USER -d $DB_NAME -c "SELECT 'tacai_dev OK' as dev_status;"
scripts.db:test:stg: set -a && source .env.stg && PGPASSWORD=$DB_PASS /opt/homebrew/opt/postgresql@16/bin/psql -h $DB_HOST -p $DB_PORT -U $DB_USER -d $DB_NAME -c "SELECT 'tacai_stg OK' as stg_status;"
scripts.db:test:prd: set -a && source .env.prd && PGPASSWORD=$DB_PASS /opt/homebrew/opt/postgresql@16/bin/psql -h $DB_HOST -p $DB_PORT -U $DB_USER -d $DB_NAME -c "SELECT 'tacai_prd OK' as prd_status;"
